title: Picking one note among 10,000: Raycaster against GPU ID picking
question: With 10,000 note markers in one InstancedMesh, how long does one pick take with THREE.Raycaster, and with an ID pass rendered into a 1x1 render target and read back, and do they agree?
hypothesis: Raycaster tests every instance on the CPU, so it grows with the note count; the ID pass costs a readback round trip that doesn't depend on the count. At 10,000 notes the GPU pick is faster, and both pick the same note except on silhouettes.

predictions.metric: median ms per pick, Raycaster, 10,000 notes
median ms per pick, GPU ID pass with readRenderTargetPixelsAsync, 10,000 notes (WebGPU)
agreement over 200 picks at fixed pseudo-random points
median ms per pick, Raycaster, 1,000 notes
predictions.predicted: under a quarter of the 10,000-note time
